# Muhammad Hamza Fazal

> Software Engineering Student, Native Android App Developer, Web Developer & Digital Marketing SEO Strategist in Pakistan.

## About
Muhammad Hamza Fazal (also known as Hamza Fazal) is an Android Developer, Next.js Web Developer, and Digital Marketing Specialist based in Islamabad / Rawalpindi, Pakistan. He builds native mobile apps using Java, Room DB, Firebase, and MVVM architecture, alongside responsive web applications built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

## Core Skills & Technologies
- **Android Mobile Development**: Java, Android Studio, XML UI, Room Database, Firebase & Firestore, MVVM Architecture, Retrofit REST APIs.
- **Web Development**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript (ES6+), WordPress, HTML5/CSS3.
- **Digital Marketing & Growth**: On-Page & Technical SEO, Keyword Research, Content Strategy, Google Analytics, Conversion Rate Optimization.

## Key Software Projects
- **Traffic Sign Test & Driving Quiz App**: Android App built with Java & Room DB to prepare users for driving license road sign exams. [Case Study](https://hamzafazal.deesu.org/projects/traffic-quiz)
- **Matric Guru (Learning Hub)**: 9th & 10th Class Android notes and study portal with Firebase sync. [Case Study](https://hamzafazal.deesu.org/projects/learning-hub)
- **Safety 24/7 SOS Alert**: Emergency personal safety mobile app with GPS location sharing and SMS alerts. [Case Study](https://hamzafazal.deesu.org/projects/safety-247)
- **Digital Khata / Shop Manager**: Small business retail ledger and credit management app. [Case Study](https://hamzafazal.deesu.org/projects/digital-khata)
- **Chicken Supply Manager**: Poultry supply chain inventory and delivery tracking platform. [Case Study](https://hamzafazal.deesu.org/projects/chicken-supply-manager)
